edinburgh_boutique_keeper.text: Come in, come in. Kilts on the left, tweed on the right, regret in the middle.

then.text: That {worn_coat} would stand up to an Edinburgh August. That's a high bar, mind.
A {worn_hat} on the Grassmarket. They hanged people here once, so cheer up, you've done well.
That {worn_top} is decent. Now, a kilt would finish it. Ask me how I know.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Plain as porridge, today. We've lots of cures.

edinburgh_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
